themes_detail.label: Street Condition Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street conditions in Riverdale have deteriorated dramatically THIS WEEK, with 130 complaints filed compared to a baseline of 14.5 per week—an 797% spike—suggesting infrastructure failure across the district that demands immediate investigation into what triggered this sudden collapse.
evidence: 130 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 14.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (797% spike, z-score: 12.58)
Represents single highest statistical anomaly in district 311 data
Community board has repeatedly requested 'Improve traffic and pedestrian safety' funding, suggesting chronic infrastructure neglect
reporting_angles: Ground-truth reporting: drive district streets to document potholes, cracks, flooding, or other visible defects triggering complaints
Interview DOT to understand what weather event, maintenance failure, or construction activity triggered the spike THIS WEEK specifically

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building and use violations in Riverdale spiked 700% THIS WEEK with 6 complaints versus a baseline of 0.8 per week, coinciding with 284 DOB permit filings in the last 90 days, suggesting construction activity may be creating safety or code compliance risks.
evidence: 6 building/use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 4.82)
284 DOB permit filings in last 90 days (173 alterations, 68 new buildings) indicate active construction season
Multiple SNAD applications pending (5204 Arlington Ave, 5294 Sycamore Ave) suggesting development pressure
reporting_angles: Examine which specific projects are generating complaints and whether DOB enforcement is keeping pace with construction activity
Interview residents near active construction sites about what violations they're reporting

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Dirty conditions complaints doubled THIS WEEK to 35 versus 13.5 weekly average (159% spike), while unsanitary animal complaints spiked 967% two weeks ago, together suggesting a coordinated sanitation breakdown affecting residential cleanliness and pest management.
evidence: 35 dirty condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 13.5 weekly average (159% spike, z-score: 4.46)
4 unsanitary animal complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% spike, z-score: 5.21)
3 dumpster complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (500% spike, z-score: 5.0)—suggests waste management failure
reporting_angles: Interview Sanitation Department about staffing, collection schedules, or equipment failures in CD 208 over past 2-3 weeks
Document dirty streets, sidewalks, and dumpster overflow conditions on foot to verify complaint patterns

themes_detail.label: Winter Storm Aftermath
themes_detail.summary: Snow and ice complaints surged 575% two weeks ago (328 complaints vs. 48.6 weekly average), while damaged tree complaints remain 529% above baseline (11 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 1.8 weekly average), indicating significant winter weather damage not yet fully cleared.
evidence: 328 snow/ice complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 48.6 weekly average (575% spike, z-score: 4.41)
11 damaged tree complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 1.8 weekly average (529% spike, z-score: 5.18)
Community board repeatedly requests 'Reconstruct or upgrade park or amenity' and 'New equipment for maintenance'—understaffed to handle cleanup
reporting_angles: Assess whether Parks Department has completed tree removal and street clearing in Riverdale, or if backlog remains
Interview residents about lingering hazards from the storm 2-3 weeks ago

themes_detail.label: Construction-Related Plumbing Issues
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints rose 175% last week (11 complaints vs. 4.0 weekly average), occurring alongside heavy DOB permit activity (68 new buildings, 173 alterations filed), suggesting construction work is damaging existing building systems.
evidence: 11 general construction/plumbing complaints LAST WEEK vs. 4.0 weekly average (175% spike, z-score: 4.95)
284 DOB permit filings in last 90 days creating concurrent construction activity district-wide
Baseline plumbing complaints remain elevated at 389 over 90 days, suggesting chronic issues exacerbated by construction
reporting_angles: Interview DOB about construction oversight and accountability for damage to existing utility infrastructure
Survey residents near active permits to identify patterns of water damage or service interruption
